title: States of Magic
summary: Resting, Charged, Overcharged, Festering, Supercritical, and Exhausted.
pages: Resting begins at 100. Charged power begins above it. Greater accumulation eventually becomes Overcharged, then Festering.
At extreme levels magic becomes Supercritical. At the other end lies Exhaustion: a witch emptied so thoroughly that even an altar may refuse to answer until recovery.
